name: POLICY_VALIDATION_V1
input: template id or explicit Critical/Major/Minor tier definitions
steps: resolve percentages from finite decimal percentage text into required_percentage_millionths exactly; reject <=0, >100%, more than 6 decimal percentage places, NaN/infinity/exponent ambiguity or any rounded conversion
resolve each finite positive duration input (days/hours/seconds) into an exact rational number of seconds; reduce numerator/denominator by gcd and enforce bounds
require at least one tier for each base severity critical, major and minor; reject independently supplied non_fault_inquiry tiers because Beta derives them

within each base severity reject exact duplicate percentage+duration tier pairs; assign deterministic tier_ordinal by ascending maximum duration then ascending required percentage then canonical input identity
for every Minor tier generate one Non-fault inquiry tier preserving required_percentage_millionths and tier ordinal while multiplying duration by exact 3/2 and reducing the resulting fraction
validate generated total tier count against semantic collection bound and ensure every derived tier points to its exact Minor source tier
serialize the complete base+derived policy canonically and compute policy content fingerprint for preview/idempotent semantic equality
rules: tiers are independent cohort requirements; policy need not use an 85/100 pair
inclusive maximum duration is retained exactly and presentation rounding has no authority
template source is provenance only after materialization under a specific Contract Product Line
policy revision validation never reads or rewrites existing SRs; retroactive live recalculation occurs by selecting the new current revision on subsequent projections
